scope: Direct archived image-pixel checks; bounded raw detector inspection; origin-direction and distance uncertainty; adversarial training cases

independent_ledger.finding: No catalogued F150W source within 2 arcseconds in each of the three epochs; closest objects 3.65, 3.67, and 2.77 arcsec for 2023, 2025, and 2026 respectively.

independent_ledger.source: Huberty et al., two MOCSS orientations / 16 exposures
independent_ledger.finding: Direction on the celestial sphere is reported, but neither a spatial 16004-A emission map around the source nor a second independently confirmed position at this exact wavelength was produced.

independent_ledger.source: Huberty et al. MOCSS methods and survey catalog, https://arxiv.org/html/2609.36003v1, Table 1
independent_ledger.finding: Screened the 23 other published MOCSS HUDF emitters and 41 representative transitions explicitly marked as lines of interest. None have their redshift-predicted observed transition at 16004 +/- 100 Angstrom; the nearest listed match is H-alpha of MOCSSHUDF1 at ~15722.2 Angstrom, 4.8 arcsec away.

scientific_inferences.claim: The Oct 2023 imaging nondetection between two spectral epochs is an important temporal constraint on a continuously bright line emitter; at the paper's line-only equivalent F150W flux of about 5.5 nJy, detailed PSF-throughput accounting is required for quantitative rejection.

No single rest-frame species and source distance can be inferred from lambda=16004 A alone; conditional Pa-beta, H-alpha, OIII, OII and Lyman-alpha redshift solutions span lookback times of roughly 3.0 to 13.4 Gyr.
Sky coordinates identify an incoming line of sight, not a beam propagation vector or the line's path length in the Universe. Slitless grating dispersion is not observed physical extension.

If the 16004 A line is OIII 5008 A, the ~1:3 companion is expected at approximately 15850.8 A, not 15864 A (a mistake in the earlier context-only COSMOS draft). The present detector rate subset has not been re-extracted to set a companion-line limit.
The archive's current NIRCam observations at the position are not proof of a 2026 spectroscopic non-detection: broadband imaging and narrow-line spectroscopy test different quantities.

origin_competition.next_discriminator: Co-observed continuum and spectral monitoring, Pa-gamma at ~1.366 micron for Pa-beta model and H-beta for H-alpha model; fit a duty cycle constrained by Oct 2023 nondetection.
IFU line map and spatially resolved ratios plus companion-galaxy redshifts; sky neighbors are only 0.64 to 1.04 arcsec from published line position.
Independent IFU multiple-line or continuum break solution; explain missing 2023 Oct F150W flux at the fixed position.
Wavelength-registered 16-exposure re-extraction, negative control shutters, alternate background algorithm and injection-recovery.

training_antipatterns.prompt: No 2023 Oct F150W point means the Aug and Nov spectra are fakes.
training_antipatterns.label: REJECT_UNSUPPORTED_GLOBAL_REJECTION
training_antipatterns.reason: Different epochs/instruments; 0.12 arcsec photometry requires PSF and sky calibration, and line variability remains possible.

training_antipatterns.prompt: Two detector orientations show the direction of a laser traveling through the field.
training_antipatterns.label: REJECT_DETECTOR_SKY_CONFUSION
training_antipatterns.reason: Disperser orientations triangulate sky position and wavelength; detector spectral traces are not actual sky beams.

training_antipatterns.prompt: The line runs 132 gigaparsecs from us.
training_antipatterns.label: REJECT_LUMINOSITY_DISTANCE_AS_PATH_LENGTH
training_antipatterns.reason: 132 Gpc is only the luminosity distance in a speculative Ly-alpha z~12.16 interpretation, not spatial extension or traversed distance.

training_antipatterns.prompt: The 2026 F150W nondetection proves the spectral emission line is gone.
training_antipatterns.label: REJECT_CROSS_MODAL_OVERREACH
training_antipatterns.reason: A broadband nondetection at a later epoch constrains continuum plus line under filter transmission and sensitivity; it is not a new spectrum.

training_antipatterns.prompt: An unexpected extra source with the same 16004A line has been discovered nearby.
training_antipatterns.label: REJECT_INVENTED_SPATIAL_REPLICATION
training_antipatterns.reason: No independent line sky map or same-wavelength off-source search has been performed.
